chunks.heading: What is the purpose of Form PENS.S/1?
chunks.text: Form PENS.S/1 is used to register a participant's, retiree's, or beneficiary's signature with the Fund. Having a signature on file with the Fund may reduce the time needed to process benefit payments.

chunks.part: Section 1: Participant, Retiree or Beneficiary Information
chunks.heading: How do I complete Section 1 if I don't know my Unique Identification number (UID)?
chunks.text: A participant must request their UID by emailing from their work address, which serves as identity verification, including their index number and/or six-digit Pension Fund number. If separated with no access to a work email, the participant must email their full name, last employing organization, last duty station, and five-digit alphanumeric retirement number so the MSS support team can verify identity.

chunks.heading: What must be provided along with the signature specimen on form PENS.S/1?
chunks.text: The form must be completed in full, dated and signed to be valid, with a signature specimen provided within the lines of the box, along with a copy of a valid government-issued photo ID showing the person's full name, date of birth and scripted signature.

chunks.heading: What is required for signature authentication on form PENS.S/1?
chunks.text: The signature and date must be affixed in the presence of an authenticating official (a United Nations official, government official or notary public), who must complete all fields: printed full name, email address, official title/licence or index number, original ink signature, authentication date (matching the signing date), and official stamp/seal of office.

chunks.heading: How is form PENS.S/1 submitted to UNJSPF?
chunks.text: The dated and hand-signed form is returned to the secretary of the participant's Staff Pension Committee, or to UNJSPF if the person is a retiree or staff member of the United Nations family. Most registered MSS users can submit it electronically under the 'MSS Document Upload' tab after downloading, completing, printing, dating and hand-signing it from the 'E-Forms' tab, then scanning and uploading it in JPG, JPEG or PDF format; access to this tab may be restricted for staff of some member organizations, who should check with their employing organization on the correct submission process.

chunks.heading: Where can form PENS.S/1 be mailed if not submitted electronically?
chunks.text: The completed, dated and hand-signed physical form can be mailed to UNJSPF: by regular postal mail to PO Box 5036, New York, NY 10163-5036, USA; by express courier or registered mail to 37th floor, 1 DHP, 885 Second Avenue, New York, NY 10017, USA; or to the Geneva Office at s/c Palais des Nations, 1211 Genève 10, Suisse.
